summary: Run complete; nothing further is completable in the remaining seconds and the record needs no closing artifact, so this points at the already-retained update. Final state: three execution-grounded defects, each with retained receipts, declared comparisons, witnesses and scoped limits — the RestoreCommittedLogs startup replay that blocks NewRaft past 128 replay batches of the FSM channel, the VerifyLeader tally that counts nonvoter acknowledgements toward a voter quorum and, under per-node timers, outlived a competing leader in twenty of twenty trials while coinciding with committed state the confirming leader lacked in twelve of twelve, and the AddVoter change that installs a Voter immediately against two published descriptions promising staging, stranding a single-voter cluster until the added server runs. Five suspicions were refuted with evidence, one behaviour entry corrected under its own id with its affected use answered, every registered question answered, and my own earlier readings narrowed by their receipts and retained.
